notes: `בֵּית יְהוָה` has no preposition morpheme; the supplied *into* goes to the directional accusative under rule 33, with a supplied *the* on the construct under rule 29.
`כָל` is itself what the *any* renders, so the noun keeps only *vow* (rule 15).
The suffix of `שְׁנֵיהֶם` is realized by the demonstrative *these* rather than by *of them* (rule 18).
